title: Design: the below-cost warning beside a grid value
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, three ranges with Default on Margin % 40, tier A on % Off 95 in every range.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Point at the warning icon beside tier A's first-range value.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • A small orange triangle with an exclamation mark shows to the right of tier A's value in each range.
  • Default's values show no triangle.
  • Tier A's values sit in the same place as the other columns' values, as in picture 15.1.

Step 3:

  • A dark tooltip just below the icon reads tier A's name, "sells a", a cost and "part below cost."
  • The tooltip's position and colours match picture 15.1 compared with the design picture at 100% zoom.
